evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically during growth: 6.6 → 12.0 → 16.0 → 20.7 → 27.2 ppm after stable ~6-8 ppm through ramp
Tube pressure creeping up 2.97 → 3.04 → 3.07 → 3.12 → 3.21 Torr at constant Ar flow
MFC steady at ~100 sccm, so pressure/O2 rise is not flow-driven

args.missing_evidence: Whether O2/pressure continue rising (leak) or plateau; a flow-step or pump-isolation rate-of-rise test would distinguish an air leak from exhaust restriction or outgassing.
